name: Handcrafted Animation Video Briefs
body: # FLUX 3 animation and design prompts Six original animation briefs. Handmade cadence and stylized material are creative directions, not claims about configurable output frame rates. ## N01 — The button observatory **Use:** handcrafted miniature story **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** felt colors; preserve character and mechanism count. ```text A tiny felt astronomer with a rust-colored cap operates a cardboard observatory on a worktable. The dome is made of stitched blue paper, and its simple telescope points through one opening. Original character and set. 00:00–00:06 — Locked miniature-wide shot. The astronomer turns a visible wooden crank. The dome moves in small tactile stop-motion increments around the fixed telescope. 00:06–00:12 — A loose white button rolls into the opening and comes to rest beside the telescope. The astronomer bends to inspect its four holes as if they were a star chart. 00:12–00:18 — The character carefully places the button on a little paper pedestal, then aims the telescope toward it. Hold the absurdly serious pose. LOCK: Felt seams, cap shape, four button holes, telescope size and crank connection. No real human hand enters. AUDIO: Cardboard friction, wood ticks, one button rattle and room hush. No speech or recognizable melody. AVOID: glossy plastic, smooth live-action character motion, floating gears, real night sky replacing the tabletop, existing mascots, text or watermark. ``` ## N02 — The umbrella diagram **Use:** original hand-drawn character animation **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 18 seconds **Adjust:** drawing materials, keeping the visual joke intact. ```text Use clean original 2D linework, restrained cel shading and a painted art-classroom background. Two adult design students examine a small paper umbrella on a desk. One wears round glasses and a mustard vest; the other a teal overshirt. 00:00–00:06 — Medium two-shot. The first student points to a charcoal drawing of heavy rain above a sketch of the umbrella. No readable writing. 00:06–00:12 — The second student opens the real paper umbrella under the drawing, then slowly slides the entire drawing beneath it. Keep paper stiffness and hand positions plausible. 00:12–00:18 — Both look at the now-covered storm drawing. The first student says in Japanese, exactly: "これなら、雨も休めるね。" Finish with a small smile, not a slapstick reaction. AUDIO: Paper, a delicate umbrella hinge and dry conversational Japanese. No music. LOCK: Two students, one umbrella, one drawing, same desk and light. AVOID: franchise resemblance, chibi transformation, extra dialogue, floating rain from the drawing, automatic subtitles, logos or watermark. ``` ## N03 — Folded light opener **Use:** title sequence background **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 2:1, 12 seconds **Adjust:** paper hue; add final typography in editing. ```text Create a typography-free motion-design opener using one long strip of matte ivory paper on a dark studio tabletop. The paper is the only moving object; show deliberate stylized animation, not a physics demonstration. 00:00–00:04 — Orthographic overhead camera. The strip forms two broad folds, leaving its continuous edge visible. Soft side light creates readable shadows. 00:04–00:08 — The folds open slowly to reveal a clean rectangular central space. The paper slides outward without breaking into extra pieces. 00:08–00:12 — Stop all motion and hold the empty center for an editor's title. Keep generous clear margins, no generated lettering. AUDIO: Two subtle paper creases, a soft slide and one second of silence at the end. No speech or song. LOCK: One continuous strip, consistent width, ivory material and fixed camera. AVOID: torn edges, metal reflections, confetti, spontaneous letters, camera rotation, ornamental symbols, logos or watermark. ``` ## N04 — Three words, three cards **Use:** exact-copy motion typography test **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 3:4, 15 seconds **Adjust:** card colors only; keep the quoted text unchanged for evaluation. ```text Create a flat editorial animation with three large paper cards on a warm-gray background. Camera remains orthographic. Each card carries one short word, centered in a plain readable sans serif. 00:00–00:05 — First card enters from above and stops. Its exact English text is "LISTEN". Hold it fully readable for two seconds. 00:05–00:10 — First card moves to the upper third. A second card enters beneath it with exact simplified Chinese text "倾听". Keep the lines separate and stable. 00:10–00:15 — Third card enters at the bottom with exact Spanish text "ESCUCHA". Hold all three cards still for the final three seconds. AUDIO: One soft paper tap for each arrival, quiet studio ambience. No speech or music. LOCK: Exactly three cards and three lines; unchanged letterforms after arrival. These are generated-text tests requiring human review. AVOID: translations appearing twice, random glyphs, distorted Chinese strokes, perspective tilt, extra punctuation, captions, logos or watermark. ``` ## N05 — Clay coastline **Use:** stop-motion spatial transformation **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 16:9, 20 seconds **Adjust:** miniature terrain colors; retain the single-channel layout. ```text Build a small tactile clay landscape on a visible rectangular tabletop base. Tan hills border one narrow blue clay river reaching a flat blue sea. This is an artistic miniature, not a geography lesson. 00:00–00:06 — Locked overhead-wide view. The river surface advances in subtle hand-animated ripples while its banks stay fixed. 00:06–00:14 — Three small white clay boats, already visible at the river mouth, turn one at a time toward the open sea. Keep each boat a simple solid shape. 00:14–00:20 — Camera gently lowers to an oblique angle, revealing fingerprints and the table edge. Boats stop within the existing water area. Hold the miniature scale. AUDIO: Soft clay handling-inspired Foley and very faint room ambience, not ocean-sized surf. LOCK: Three boats, river course, base dimensions and visibly handmade texture. AVOID: real ocean transition, boats duplicating, terrain growing, hidden cuts, photoreal people, place names, title text or watermark. ``` ## N06 — A shadow with manners **Use:** playful character animation and timing **Mode:** text to video · **Format:** 1:1, 15 seconds **Adjust:** original character costume, maintaining one cast shadow. ```text An original flat-illustrated courier with a square blue bag stands before a small yellow door. One long dark shadow extends to the right. Use a simple textured-paper background, not an existing character style. 00:00–00:05 — Courier raises a hand to knock. The shadow politely knocks first, one beat ahead. This intentional impossible timing is the only visual gag. 00:05–00:10 — Courier looks down and waits. The shadow straightens, returns to alignment, then makes a small apologetic bow. 00:10–00:15 — Courier finally knocks once; both real hand and shadow now move together. The door opens a few centimeters, but no new character is revealed. AUDIO: Two different knock moments, light fabric rustle and a soft hinge. No speech, music or laughter. LOCK: Same bag, door size, paper texture, character proportions and shadow direction. AVOID: multiple shadows, extra limbs, uncontrolled morphing, facial features on the shadow, readable signs, logos or watermark. ```
description_en: Six original animation briefs — felt stop-motion, hand-drawn character, folded-paper title background, motion typography, clay terrain and a shadow that acts on its own — each with timed beats and a material continuity lock.
description_zh: 六条原创动画简报——毛毡定格、手绘角色、折纸标题背景、动态文字排版、黏土地貌，以及一个自作主张的影子——每条都带节拍时间线与材质连续性锁定。
long_en: The briefs describe handmade cadence as a directing choice rather than a frame-rate setting: stitched paper domes moving in tactile increments, visible felt seams, cardboard friction in the audio bed. One brief is an exact-copy typography test where the quoted words must render unchanged so the result can be evaluated; another animates a character's cast shadow while forbidding extra shadows, extra limbs or facial features on the shadow. Every brief ends with LOCK, AUDIO and AVOID blocks that fix material texture, character proportions and mechanism counts across the clip.
long_zh: 这些简报把手工质感当作导演选择而非帧率参数：拼贴纸圆顶以可触知的小步幅转动、毛毡缝线清晰可见、音床里有纸板摩擦声。其中一条是原样文字的动态排版测试，引号内的词必须一字不改地渲染出来以便评估效果；另一条让角色的投影自行动作，同时禁止出现多重影子、多余肢体或影子上的五官。每条简报都以 LOCK、AUDIO、AVOID 段落收尾，锁定材质纹理、角色比例与机构件数量在全片保持一致。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. All characters and sets are specified as original, and the AVOID lists explicitly ban recognizable franchise design, readable signage and logos — but that is prompt guidance, not enforcement, so review generated output before publishing. Written and named for FLUX 3, whose availability is staged; the structure transfers to other video models, exact behaviour will not. The source repo is run by the commercial API reseller bestimage.ai; these prompt files carry no product placement.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。所有角色与场景都被指定为原创，AVOID 清单也明确禁止可识别的知名 IP 设计、可读招牌与商标——但这只是提示词层面的约束而非强制手段，发布前请自行审核生成结果。以 FLUX 3 命名与撰写，而该模型分阶段开放；这套结构可迁移到其它视频模型，但具体表现不会一致。来源仓库由商业 API 转售商 bestimage.ai 运营，不过这些提示词文件没有产品植入。
